change: A Python package's make targets are pubkit's: sync manages pubkit-python.mk (venv, functional, lock, sync-check, wheel, clean, help; the suite on every core, PYTEST_ARGS ?= -n auto, its coverage combined into coverage/coverage.xml; FUNCTIONAL_ENV and EDITABLE for what differs) and seeds a Makefile that includes it, and sync --check fails until the Makefile includes it and pyproject.toml's [tool.coverage.run] sets patch = ["subprocess"] and parallel = true
